events.name: Haggis X-1 w/s/g Brian Thomas Trio
events.info: Haggis X-1 is bringing a full-force Celtic rock celebration to Middle Ages Music Hall! Built around veteran members of Enter the Haggis, Haggis X-1 carries forward a 30-year legacy of high-energy performances, unforgettable songs, and modern Celtic pub anthems like , "rdquo" -> One Last Drink" and , "rdquo" -> Down With The Ship." Featuring driving rhythms, pipes, fiddle, big choruses, and communal singalongs, Haggis X-1 delivers a powerful live show packed with beloved Enter the Haggis favorites and fresh new material. This is Celtic rock made for the stage: fiery, melodic, and built to get the room moving. Join us at Middle Ages Music Hall for a night of big hooks, high-energy musicianship, and a celebration you won't want to miss. PRESENTED BY VISIONS FCU
